restaurantName: Auberge du Château de Leignon par Isabelle Arpin
bio: Today, the neo-Gothic Château de Leignon is home to a variety of businesses, including a brewery and, of course, this charming restaurant run by Isabelle Arpin, whose market-fresh cuisine showcases ingredients from local producers. Look forward to playful dishes that draw inspiration from all over the world – for example, she pairs brill with barley infused with coffee, artichoke, a creamy fish sauce and a sabayon with aged rum. Be sure to sample the creations of the local brewery, whose beers frequently find their way into the desserts....
pageTitle: Auberge du Château de Leignon par Isabelle Arpin
